Certificate of Employment / 在职证明
按接收方要求填写，证件号等敏感字段仅在明确要求时加入。

This is to certify that [Employee name] has worked at [Company name] as [Job title] in [Department] from [Start date] to [End date or present].
Their main responsibilities include [brief description].
Issued on [Date] by [Name and title].
Contact: [Business email or phone]
[Signature / company stamp, if required]

兹证明[姓名]自[入职日期]至[离职日期或今]在[公司名称][部门]担任[岗位]。主要职责为[简述]。
签发日期：[日期]
签发人及职位：[姓名及职位]
单位联系方式：[邮箱或电话]
[签字或公章，按要求填写]
